user.title: Connect to the Rust Matrix bridge
user.description: Start the Matrix NG bridge first. Matrix credentials and recovery keys stay in the bridge, not Home Assistant. Use HTTPS unless the bridge is on a trusted local connection.

room.title: Choose an encrypted room
room.description: Only joined, encrypted rooms from the bridge allowlist are shown.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Matrix bridge.
error.invalid_auth: The bridge API token is invalid.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
error.invalid_response: The bridge returned an invalid or incompatible response.
error.not_ready: The Matrix bridge has not completed sync. Check its logs and try again.

abort.already_configured: This encrypted room is already configured for this bridge.
abort.no_encrypted_rooms: No joined encrypted rooms are available. Add room IDs to the bridge allowlist and join the account to those rooms using a Matrix client.
abort.wrong_account: Reconnect to the same bridge URL and Matrix account.

send_message.name: Send encrypted message
send_message.description: Send a message via the Rust Matrix SDK. Unencrypted rooms are refused.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional title prepended to the message.

room_id.name: Room ID
room_id.description: Optional internal room ID; must be in the bridge allowlist. Defaults to the configured room.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Required when multiple Matrix NG entries are loaded.

transaction_id.name: Transaction ID
transaction_id.description: Optional stable ID for retries: letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, at most 128 bytes. Reuse only for the same message.
